text:
marta: FYI carrier updated — a batch of RMAs is stuck at the north-eu crossdock due to a customs hold. need plan for serial ownership & replacement routing.
ryan: which RMAs/serials are affected? any ETA?
marta: list below (from vendor manifest):
```
RMA-987654 -> S/N GPU-0A12-B34C (node gpu-node-42)
RMA-987655 -> S/N GPU-0A12-B35D (node gpu-node-43)
RMA-987656 -> S/N GPU-0A12-B36E (node gpu-node-44)
```
ryan: ack. vendor ticket?
marta: vendor ticket VND-4521, vendor-bot said "On hold - awaiting commercial invoice" earlier.
vendor-bot: VND-4521 status update: "On Hold - Customs docs requested by carrier. Last scan: crossdock-north-eu 2026-02-12 09:12Z" :package:
sophie: we have 3 spares in the ams pool (quantum-64 cards) that can be prepped. lead time to dispatch same-day if we mark them priority and use express courier.
devon: can we avoid a full depot swap? prefer to ship spares to the datacenter and keep RMAs returning to vendor later. will reduce downtime.
ryan: ok, plan: 1) mark affected nodes drained, 2) issue internal placeholder tickets tying node->serial->RMA, 3) ship spares to datacenter, 4) update inventory when vendor completes RMA inbound.
marta: agree. @devon can you cordon/drain nodes? small rolling drain ok. commands: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-42 && kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
devon: on it. doing gpu-node-42 now. will do 43/44 next.
sophie: booking courier now. shipping from AMS depot -> FRA-dc on express. I put tracking on the internal ticket: INT-2041. ETA tomorrow morning EET.
ryan: i've created placeholder tickets in JIRA: INFRA-3120/3121/3122 and linked to VND-4521. adding a note to not close until vendor confirms return.
marta: inventory note: set serials S/N GPU-0A12-B34C/B35D/B36E to status "pending-return" and clear assignment in cluster after replacement is live.
vendor-bot: VND-4521 comment added by diego.vendor: "We will expedite customs docs — targeting 24-48h. Will update manifest when released."
devon: replacement nodes live for gpu-node-42. monitoring perf. no regressions so far.
ryan: look into cost hit for express shipping and spare usage; tag cost center ENG-INFRA and runbook step to rotate spares back when vendor returns replaced cards.
sophie: note — courier requested signature; need on-site ops to accept and install. @marta can you confirm FRA-dc on-call window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 CET?
marta: confirmed. i'll ping on-call and SRE runbook owner.
ryan: thanks everyone. will keep thread open until RMAs clear customs. :thumbsup:
marta: thanks — marking thread with inventory checklist and next steps.
